speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You'll not put a shoe on that foot. Sit.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The list for the winter, written fair. Then you may open what you like.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Provisions. I can do provisions in one line and be done by the half hour.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Provisions is how a man forgets what he has eaten. Write the things.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Strike out provisions. Salt first, and write it twice. Bay salt for the beef-tub. White salt for the trencher.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: A peck of the white is a house. We are not a ship. The bay is the tub's, and it is not the same peck.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two salts. And candles. One dozen.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Three lines for light, Will, not one. Moulded tallow for the hall, dipped tens for the chambers, and rush-lights for the kitchen and the back stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have spent ten years calling all three a candle.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: In Bishopsgate thou buyest tallow at a chandler's door and thinkest the house is lit. Here we render the fat and peel the rushes. Write three lines.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: And the rush-lights are peeled in this house, if you mean them to last. Two bundles. Not a chandler's knot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Malt. Four bushels for the house.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four was what we had in a good year.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Two. The rest is a hope, and a hope is not a line.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Pale malt for the small beer at harvest. Brown, dried higher, for the winter keeping. Two lines. The bushels separate. The two is the house.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Let me see the ground the barley comes from.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The old furlong beyond the brook. I have written it as I say it in London.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Thou hast spelt the old field-name the way Londoners say it, with their mouths clipped short. There is an l in the middle of that ground.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: An l in the middle. I had forgotten the l.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Put it back. A name is not improved by being carried up to Cheapside and brought home thin.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: And the soap is not soap. Bought soap ate the linen in June. I said so then.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Write that the house boils it. Write Joan's name on the line, since the quarrel is hers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house boils it. Joan's name is on the line. I am not taking a side past the line.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: You have bushels on the first leaf and bushelles on the scrap. The second is not a word.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Bushels. I will pick the one a man can say.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Two leaves. Fair, not clever. It wants ten minutes of ten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two leaves by ten, and not a king or a lover on either of them.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. Stay seated till the fair copy is dry. The shoe is not a reward.
